facts.text: Human simulation examines how an operator responds when a machine warns, waits and then brakes, rather than whether a sensor detects a person.
facts.quote: Human simulation answers a different question: not "did the sensor detect the person?" but "what does the operator do when the machine warns, waits and then brakes?".

facts.text: The University of Queensland and ACARP proximity-advisory project used a 5DT haul-truck simulator to evaluate visual and auditory proximity interfaces with the aim of reducing collision probability.
facts.quote: The University of Queensland and ACARP proximity-advisory project used a 5DT haul-truck simulator to evaluate visual and auditory proximity interfaces with the aim of reducing collision probability

facts.text: The University of Queensland and ACARP proximity-advisory project addressed proximity advisory and HMI, rather than automatic braking.
facts.quote: it addressed proximity advisory and HMI rather than automatic braking

facts.text: The accessible project page for the University of Queensland and ACARP proximity-advisory project does not state a clear publication date; the work is approximately 2017-era.
facts.quote: the accessible project page does not state a clear publication date (the work is about 2017-era)

facts.text: VR and AR pedestrian-in-the-loop and driver-simulator work exists for road vehicles.
facts.quote: VR and AR pedestrian-in-the-loop and driver-simulator work exists on the road side.

facts.text: No off-road study of operators experiencing automatic braking in a simulator was found.
facts.quote: No off-road study of operators experiencing automatic braking in a simulator was found.

facts.text: Simulator studies can examine warning timing, operator surprise at automatic intervention, nuisance-warning workload, simultaneous manual braking, override behaviour, trust and HMI comprehension.
facts.quote: Simulator studies can examine warning timing, whether automatic intervention surprises the operator, nuisance-warning workload, simultaneous manual braking, override behaviour, trust and HMI comprehension.

facts.text: Operator simulator studies cannot validate real sensors or braking hardware.
facts.quote: They cannot validate real sensors or braking hardware

facts.text: Operator simulator studies cannot reproduce motion cues perfectly.
Operator simulator studies cannot establish long-term complacency, risk compensation, production pressure or behaviour after months of nuisance interventions.
facts.quote: or establish long-term complacency, risk compensation, production pressure or behaviour after months of nuisance interventions.

facts.text: ICMM and EMESRT identify that human performance can change both positively and negatively after technology is introduced.
facts.quote: ICMM and EMESRT identify "that Human Performance can change both positively and negatively after technology is introduced".
